purpose: Register conservative Vietnamese official-reference paths for both target statuses without treating regulator warnings or issuer listings as labels and without authorizing generic scraping.

sources.name: State Securities Commission of Vietnam investor warnings
sources.raw_semantics: An official warning can identify a reported or warned entity, domain, impersonation, or conduct. It is not automatically the model target and does not prove every associated artifact belongs to one campaign.
prohibited_uses: absence from the warning index as legitimacy evidence
generic automated scraping under this review

terms_and_access_review.finding: The public official index exposes Vietnamese investor-warning titles, dates, and individual warning pages. This review did not identify an explicit bulk export or machine-reuse license on the reviewed official page.
terms_and_access_review.operational_decision: Use manual record-level review or a future explicit official export only. Preserve the official URL, observation time, minimal identity/domain facts, and local hash; do not automate enumeration under this addendum.
terms_and_access_review.redistribution_decision: Keep source captures internal and do not redistribute complete pages or attachments without a separate item-level rights review.
terms_and_access_review.blocker: No explicit bulk/download path or reuse permission has been registered.

sources.name: Hanoi Stock Exchange issuer and listed-security profiles
sources.raw_semantics: An HNX issuer profile can support entity, listing, and official-domain reconciliation. Listing or publication by HNX is not a safety guarantee and cannot establish that a website capture is authentic, uncompromised, or legitimate.
prohibited_uses: listing as proof of content safety
generic automated scraping under this review
market data or issuer profile text as model input
redistribution of HNX page or data bundles

terms_and_access_review.finding: HNX public pages expose issuer identity and website fields. The reviewed official notice states HNX copyright and instructs users to contact HNX when publishing information from the website.
terms_and_access_review.operational_decision: Use manual record-level review or an explicit official export/permission only. Retain only minimal derived identity facts internally with source URL, observation time, and hash; do not automate enumeration under this addendum.
terms_and_access_review.redistribution_decision: Do not republish HNX page/data bundles. Any external release requires a separate permission and rights review.
terms_and_access_review.blocker: No explicit machine-readable export permission or project-specific republication permission has been registered.
